novelty.justification: The claim asks whether models "internally encode a regime-boundary" whose "location tracks the true boundary condition," making the novelty route a cross-law measurement of latent domains of validity rather than merely a new scientific setting. Searches using "foundation model internal representation domain of validity physical law," "neural network latent regime boundary law breakdown," "scientific model probing applicability regime," and "representation probing physical extrapolation breakdown" found the closest work in Why Cannot Neural Networks Master Extrapolation? Insights from Physical Laws (2025) and TC-Bench's probing of scientific invariants and model collapse in intense regimes (2026), but neither characterizes whether latent transitions align with known validity boundaries across specific laws. The step is a substantive natural extension combining established linear probing, change-point detection, OOD/extrapolation analysis, and applicability-domain ideas into a new unit of analysis and score, rather than a new interpretability paradigm or clearly non-routine core mechanism.
